CHAPTER 0101 / 10

A busy Christmas

A long time ago, in a big stone mansion in England, worked a young-looking man named Toby. Even though he worked hard as a helper, Toby was actually a loving dad who worked every day to take care of his family. While the rich family celebrated Christmas upstairs with presents and songs, Toby and the other helpers worked non-stop in the kitchen, washing pots and preparing food, dreaming of going home.

CHAPTER 0202 / 10

Christmas at the mansion

On Christmas Day, Toby had to help serve a giant feast to the rich family. There was a huge roasted turkey and lots of laughter. Toby watched wistfully as the rich children opened presents and played with their new toys near the giant Christmas tree. He thought about his own two children waiting for him in their small cottage.

CHAPTER 0303 / 10

A quiet, lonely evening

When the big party was over, the kitchen became quiet. Toby was exhausted. He sat down at the table by the fire, almost too tired to move. He felt very lonely and wished he could hug his children, knowing he still had so much to do.

CHAPTER 0404 / 10

A wonderful surprise

But the next morning, on December 26th, something magical happened. The kind Lord of the house came down to the kitchen. "Toby," he said with a warm smile, "yesterday you worked very hard to make our Christmas perfect. Today is your turn to rest. You have the day off to go home to your family." And he handed Toby a wooden Christmas Box tied with a red ribbon!

CHAPTER 0505 / 10

Home through the snow

Toby ran faster than ever along the snowy path through the woods. Even though it was freezing cold outside, his heart was warm with joy. He held the heavy wooden box tightly to his chest, imagining the happy faces of his wife and two little children when he arrived.

CHAPTER 0606 / 10

Daddy is back!

Toby finally reached his small stone cottage! The door flew open, and two little children ran out shouting, "Daddy! Daddy is back!" His wife greeted him with a huge, emotional hug. Toby was so happy to see them that he even dropped the box in the snow just to hold them tight. He was finally home!

CHAPTER 0707 / 10

What is in the box?

Inside the cozy cottage, everyone gathered around the wooden table. By the warm glow of the lamp, Toby, his wife, and their two children leaned in with wide eyes and wonder, ready to lift the lid of the box. What could be inside?

CHAPTER 0808 / 10

A Christmas feast

Inside was a wonderful feast! They found delicious sliced roast turkey from the mansion, sweet fruit pies, shiny gold coins, and a thick, warm wool scarf striped in red and green. The yummy smell of good food filled the whole house. Toby could finally celebrate his own Christmas!

CHAPTER 0909 / 10

The best gift of all

After eating together, Toby put on his warm new scarf and went outside into the snow with his wife and children. They ran, built a snowman, and had a joyful snowball fight full of laughter. That day, Toby didn't have to work, and his children got the best gift in the world: playing with their dad, because every child has the right to rest, laugh, and play happily with their family.

CHAPTER 1010 / 10

The meaning of Boxing Day

And that is how Toby's family celebrated their own special Christmas on December 26th. Sitting cozy and warm by the fire, they were happy and together, all thanks to the generosity of the box. From that day on, people started calling this special day Boxing Day—a day for saying "thank you," sharing, and protecting every family's time to rest and play.
